result.topic_en: Auxiliary (conditional) equations of second and third degree for solving the cyclotomic equation x^p = 1, with a table of cubic periods for primes p = 7, 13, 19, 31, 37, their reduced forms, and the cube-root expressions for their roots, plus scattered side calculations.

General form of the reduced cubic period equation with k determined by representing p=t^2+3u^2
